name: Cubillos (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a white embattled stripe along the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Cubillos (a cross of Calatrava and a tower).
history: Municipal flag of Cubillos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cubillos arms — cross of Calatrava and a tower on red
